description:
Validated immutable identity invokes the native/source, MCP, and OCI producer interfaces and preserves each exact output for root assembly.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The workflow authenticates the validation-completed record and invokes each reusable producer interface with the same candidate-event, freeze SHA/root, repository, workflow, and policy identities.
- [hard] REQ-02: Native/source, MCP, and OCI jobs expose exact artifact IDs, ZIP and subject digests, retention/expiry, attestations, and producer run identities through typed outputs; no producer can run before validation succeeds.
- [hard] REQ-03: Fixtures reject missing, foreign, expired, rebuilt, mismatched, or duplicate producer results, identity drift between jobs, source modification, and any tag, escrow, registry, or release mutation.

## Notes

Blast radius: producer-caller workflow YAML, typed output plumbing, and dispatch fixtures only; producer implementations and candidate-root assembly are outside scope.
title: Implement candidate producer-dispatch workflows
